How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for One Stop Centre Vellore Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.vellore.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the One Stop Centre Vellore recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the One Stop Centre Vellore recruitment is 21st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the post names for which recruitment is being done?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the posts of Security and Multipurpose.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is 8th Pass or 10th Pass/Fail.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Security post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Security post is Rs. 12,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Multipurpose post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Multipurpose post is Rs. 10,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply offline by sending the application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of One Stop Centre Vellore, which is https://www.vellore.nic.in.
